routing.partial: all remaining mixed or partial coverage states

training_augmentation.complete_beforeinfo: retain the observed feature tensor without fabricating unavailable values

training_augmentation.preinfo_only: mask body_weight_kg, adjust_weight_kg, exhibition_time, tilt, propeller_new, parts_count, all part_* fields, start_st/start_st_f/start_st_l/start_display_left_pct and all corresponding race-relative features on every lane; set start_st_missing to 1, both coverage features to 0, and both spread features missing
training_augmentation.normalization: fit once on fold-training observed data; a masked continuous value is represented by the normalized training mean (zero), while explicit missingness and coverage flags use their normalized target values

loss: equal mean of exact top3 NLL across the three deterministic views
baseline: v251 using existing mean-imputation and missing indicators
